# Literature Review Workflow and Techniques 

[How To Read Papers Fast & Effectively - PhD student](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EXALI6jFu6E)

Note:
1. Skim the title, abstract
2. Scan the figures
3. Read the results and method
4. Read the discussion
5. Remember more (taking note), use voice memmor
6. Connect the dot ([researchrabbit.ai](https://www.researchrabbit.ai/reviews))
7. Search the first or last author's name on youtube to see their presentation at conferences.
8.
